description:
Standard Opener for the Delhi civilization with either Castle age or Feudal direction. 

Technologies are not provided here, as they should always be queued up. This is explained in the video.

See Video Provided for Reference
name: Standard ToV Delhi Opener for Castle / Feudal Rush
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ / @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ go to @resource/resource_food.png@ (Do drop off on unbuilt @building_economy/mill.png@ if less travel distance)
Pull @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ at 3770G in Gold Vein onto @resource/resource_wood.png@  -> Queue @unit_delhi/scholar.png@
Build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ (2 if opponent is not immediatly aggressive)

Balance economy approx 50/50 to build @resource/resource_food.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.png@heavy units and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@around @resource/sacred_sites.png@. Make @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @resource/sacred_sites.png@ @resource/resource_gold.png@ .
Of course, scout opponent and build units that counter his. This is just a guide.

For Castle TIMING use @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@ (not if opponent is in castle): build 3-4 @building_military/barracks.png@ (total with scholars) and mass@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@. Send Age up vills to @resource/resource_stone.png@and @building_defensive/keep.png@-drop opponents base when pushing. Go siege, if necessary, and if you can't push, build economy with @building_defensive/keep.png@

description:
Delhi Fast Imperial build into Elephants inspired by Corvinus1 - video starts at 01:17

https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2293374213?t=4624s
name: Delhi Fast Imperial build into Elephants
author: FiddyWow

notes: @resource/rally.webp@ 3 new @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ (12 total) and 4 new @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@
@resource/rally.png@@unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.png@ to @building_religious/mosque.png@ and research all upgrades
Keep 15 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ and sent remaining @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@
At this point you can start @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@@resource/resource_stone.png@ and add more keeps on the map or kill your enemy with mass elephants + keeps insider their base.

description:
Feudal all-in guide

The upgrades are noted in priority

Video linked.
name: Feudal Timing Attack (w/ upgrade notation)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ at woodline (pull the 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ from straggler when 50@resource/resource_wood.png@)

When 12 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ start rallying to @resource/resource_food.png@ (balance eco around your unit comp. More ghazi = more on food and vice versa with archers.)
Send both @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to @resource/sacred_sites.png@ at 7 mins. Only wall @resource/sacred_sites.png@ that are furthest away (and therefore toughest to defend)
@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@finishes and you should have an upgrade advantage

You should try to have around 12 ghazi + 12 archers at min 10. Macroing with delhi just involves taking pocket resources and balancing around production. Then when you have sacred sites, you produce 5 scholars in total and then spend all your gold income in the market to boost your economy.

description: Incredibly strong ramp up leads to some insane army mass capability and/or tech timings. Use this as a feudal strat to either all in or look for a tempo advantage to go castle with.
name: Dome Of Faith Tempo Build
author: Valdemar1902

notes: @resource/rally.webp@2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to @resource/berrybush.png@ and then rest to @resource/sheep.png@ until ageup.
Take your @resource/sheep.webp@ and put them on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@. Keep @resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 10-11ish
@age/age_2.webp@: send age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ back to @resource/berrybush.png@.  Don't forget to queue all upgrades. Blacksmith upgrades are noted below.

Build a @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.png@ if against early rush cav civs. Use @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ inside prod. building if in need of fast units. (only against rush)

description:
Gameplan:
- make units (Ghazi into 1x1x1 composition)
- take sacred sites
- (optional) wall sacred sites
- trade gold for food/wood to further increase your army advantage
- sacred site win or deny food
name: DEL | 1 Mosque | Tower of Victory | Ghazi into 1x1x1
author: exe

description: See video link for more tips
name: Delhi Fast Ghazi into Age 3 (2026)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 starting @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to chop 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then build @building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@

2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ at woodline (pull the 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from straggler when 50@resource/resource_wood.webp@)
when 5 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ you @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until 12. Then @resource/resource_wood.webp@ again until 12

2@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build @building_military/stable.webp@ ( put @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/stable.webp@ and pump @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ nonstop )

@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@  @building_military/archery-range.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ in whatever order makes sense (usually go production buildings first and add 2x blacksmiths later around 8-10 mins)
Only go age 3 when you have secured 2 deer packs with @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@
In age 3 immediately queue @unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@ and add 2 more @building_military/archery-range.webp@ for @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@+@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@
5 starting @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to chop 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then build @building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@

2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ at woodline (pull the 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from straggler when 50@resource/resource_wood.webp@)
when 5 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ you @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until 14. Then @resource/resource_wood.webp@ again

2@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build @building_military/stable.webp@ ( put @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/stable.webp@ and pump @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ nonstop )

description: Tower of Victory build with a 2 mosque opening to accelerate tech and scholars to heal up units from early fights. This build is very aggressive and should be won in feudal or through aging up and dropping keeps everywhere with Compound Of The Defender.
name: ToV Ghazi/Archer/Scholar build
author: Valdemar1902

notes: @age/age_2.webp@: Queue all techs. @building_religious/mosque.png@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@ builds scholars. 1st @building_religious/mosque.png@ does the research.

Just before @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ finishes, send out 3 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ to the 3 Sacred Sites. If opponent is aggressive, take 1 site at a time with army and wall it. Keep adding army and kill in feudal, or end the game by going @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.png@, tech up your units, then drop keeps when you push opponents base.

name: Dome of Faith Guide by Beasty
author: dB

notes: 5 Villagers gather @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 10 on each Then to @resource/berrybush.webp@ ,  6th @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ builds @building_religious/mosque.webp@and then@building_economy/house.webp@ near @resource/berrybush.webp@
Move the age up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ back to @resource/berrybush.webp@

Research @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@@technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ (you can build another @building_economy/mill.webp@ to speed up)
Build @building_military/stable.webp@ and put 1@unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ into the @building_military/stable.webp@ (no matter the CIV)
Keep makings@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and put them wherever depending on your resources

If enemy has @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ otherwise @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ (remember to put @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ in @building_military/archery-range.webp@ too)
Remember to take map control to solidify @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
When @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ is almost done, move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
If playing against a knight CIV or Cavalry take 1 @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ at a time

If you have @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ you can pull @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ off @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and put them to other places @resource/resource_wood.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ otherwise keep them on gold
Depending on how the game is going,  you can pull @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ off @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and put them on @resource/resource_food.webp@ to age up quicker
@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@ is the META if you have total map control.... but you can choose for unique upgrades @landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@
At this point make 5 or 6 production buildings @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@ and research

If you chose @landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@ queue in this order..@technology_delhi/paiks.webp@@technology_delhi/honed-blades.webp@@technology_delhi/hearty-rations.webp@@technology_delhi/mahouts.webp@@technology_delhi/tranquil-venue.webp@@technology_delhi/reinforced-foundations.webp@
If the opponent has a lot of Knights get @unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@@unit_delhi/tower-elephant-3.webp@@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@
If the opponent has a lot of archers get @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@@unit_delhi/tower-elephant-3.webp@@unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@

description:
If opponent is aggressive, take 1 site at a time with army and wall it. 
Keep adding army and kill in feudal, or end the game by going Compound of the Defender, tech up your units, then drop keeps when you push opponents base. 

Gameplan:
- make units
- take sacred sites
- (maybe) wall sacred sites
- age up with compound of the defender
- take relics
- build keeps EVERYWHERE
name: 2 Mosque | Tower of Victory
author: exe
